name: Commerce Alphabank
description: Off-site redirect payment gateway for Alpha Bank (Greece) for Drupal Commerce. The callback verifies a sha256 digest keyed with the merchant shared secret (forgery-resistant).
project_description:
Module Info 
 Redirection payment for Drupal Commerce and Alphabank (Greece).

 By using the redirection method, your clients get redirected to the bank and fill in their credit card data there. No information is stored at the Drupal side. This ensures security and it costs less because there is no need for certificates on your server.

 Dependencies 
 This module's (Drupal 7) version depends on http://drupal.org/project/commerce_static_checkout_url in order to work correctly. All it does is add functionality to commerce_static_checkout_url specific to Alphabank. Upon installation check out admin/commerce/config/static_checkout_url for the links you should provide to the bank for proper communication with your Commerce site.
